The query joins Montgomery tracts to EPA facility counts and CDC adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, excludes tracts with missing population or prevalence, and returns the cross-tract correlation with paired tract count, ranked by facility rate descending.
sql:
WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tract_name,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
    COALESCE(n.n, 0) AS epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count,
    CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(h.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence,
    t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts n
    ON n.geoid = t.geoid
    AND n.run_id = 'r_20261027_f90fcf'
    AND n.source = 'm1_cdc'
    AND n.grp = 'all'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_f90fcf_m2_cdc h
    ON h.tractfips = t.geoid
  WHERE CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) > 0
    AND h.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count,
  totalpopulation,
  adult_asthma_prevalence,
  CORR(epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation, adult_asthma_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name
LIMIT 200
